answer: Here is one mechanism that works: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because glacier only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, meadow is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
